Name: Lun's Paths (CP and AT)
Author: lunink
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][color=#999999][size=1]﻿🛇 Please do not redistribute/reupload without permission![/size][/color][/b]

[color=#ea9999]
[/color][color=#dbb0a7][size=5]Lun's Paths [/size][/color][color=#dbb0a7](and stairs)[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][i]13 witchy and cottagecore-inspired floors, paths and stairs[/i][/color]

[b]──────────────── 🌙 ────────────────[/b]

Hi everyone! I'm finally brave enough to upload my first mod. (｡•ᴗ•｡)
Since playing Stardew Valley, I've often missed not being able to build stairs. (Especially at Hilltop Farm)
So I thought you might feel the same way - I hope you like this mod and find it helpful!
[img]https://s20.directupload.net/images/250116/qkaijlf9.png[/img]﻿﻿
[size=2]This mod replaces the vanilla craftable floors and paths[/size]
[size=2]Each retexture can be disabled in config.json[/size]


[color=#dbb0a7][size=3][b]✦ Requirements:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2]✧ SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/size]
[size=2]✧ Content Patcher/Alternative Textures[/size]

[color=#dbb0a7][size=3][b]✦ Installation:[/b][/size][/color]
✧ Install the latest version of SMAPI﻿
✧ Install the latest version of Content Patcher﻿/Alternative Textures
✧ Download the mod
✧ Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder
﻿✧ Run the game using SMAPI

[color=#dbb0a7][size=3][b]✦ Config Options:[/b][/size][/color]
﻿✧ The values are "true" or "false".
The default is "true", set to "false" if you wanted to keep
the vanilla texture
✧ You can turn each floor on and off in the generic mod config menu


──────────────── 🌙 ────────────────
